description: @max_rss_mb (default 750) is stored by handle_set_threshold but nothing in the codebase ever reads it - calculate_pressure hardcodes 500/650/800 and set_threshold has zero callers. Misleading API: callers believe they tuned memory thresholds but nothing changes. Either derive calculate_pressure bands from @max_rss_mb and have callers use it, or delete set_threshold/CastSetThreshold/@max_rss_mb entirely. Coordinate with the RSS metric fix which touches the same code.
title: set_threshold/max_rss_mb is write-only dead config
